name: wow-vanguard-ui-site
description: The Vanguard player website (vanguard-ui.pages.dev), generated from the addon's Lua.

scripts.check: npm run build && npm run check:encoding && npm test
scripts.dev: npx --yes wrangler@4 pages dev dist --kv FEEDBACK_KV --port 8788 --compatibility-date 2025-09-01
scripts.deploy: npx wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name vanguard-ui
